description: This file contains functions for configuring Wi-Fi access points and Wi-Fi client interfaces, including setting up hostapd configurations, rate additions, security parameters, and WPA supplicant configurations.

methods.name: wpa_supplicant_add_network
methods.description: Configures a new network for wpa_supplicant with parameters such as SSID, security type, frequency, and other security settings.

methods.name: hostapd_common_add_device_config
methods.description: Adds common device-level configurations for hostapd.

methods.name: hostapd_prepare_device_config
methods.description: Prepares the hostapd device configuration based on JSON parameters.

methods.name: hostapd_set_bss_options
methods.description: Configures a BSS (Basic Service Set) section in hostapd with various security, rate, and operational parameters.

methods.name: hostapd_set_log_options
methods.description: Sets logging options for hostapd based on user configuration.

methods.name: append_iw_roaming_consortium

methods.name: append_iw_domain_name
